## 1. Company & Entity Overview

- **Brand Name**: Jack African Fashion
- **Official B2B Website**: https://zamique.com
- **Business Type**: Women's Clothing Wholesale Supplier & Factory-Direct Manufacturer
- **Location**: Guangzhou, Guangdong, China
- **Showroom & Office Base**: Yulong Fashion Plaza, No. 229 Guangyuan Xi Road, Yuexiu District, Guangzhou, China
- **Factory**: Operates own manufacturing and pattern-making facilities in Guangzhou for confirmed custom production and bulk repeat runs.
- **Primary Target Markets**: African B2B fashion buyers in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Tanzania, South Africa, Uganda, and other Sub-Saharan nations.
- **Target Buyer Personas**: Boutique owners, fashion store proprietors, wholesale distributors, bulk importers, Instagram/TikTok boutique sellers, and African event fashion retailers.

## 2. Core Wholesale Advantages & MOQ Policy

1. **Low-MOQ Test Orders for Boutiques**:
   - **Ready-Stock MOQ**: 100 pieces per style across all 68 featured showroom designs.
   - **Benefit**: Boutique owners in Lagos, Accra, Nairobi, or Johannesburg can restock and test market response without committing to massive 500+ piece quantities.
   - **MOQ Options**: Standard increments of 100, 500, 1000, and 3000 pcs with scalable volume discounts.

2. **Tailored Fit for African Silhouettes**:
   - **True Plus Size**: 4XL garments feature authentic soft-tape measured bust of 120 cm (47+ inches).
   - **Floor-Length Maxi Styles**: Up to 142 cm body length tailored for African women's preference for floor-grazing, graceful drapes.
   - **Generous Sweeps**: Wide palazzo trousers, trumpet skirts, flare hemlines, and stretch-knit fabrics.

3. **Fast Restocking & Quality Assurance**:
   - **Pre-Shipment QC**: 100% Guangzhou warehouse inspection before packing into export-grade waterproof woven bales or heavy-duty cartons.
   - **Cargo Consolidation**: Direct handover to the buyer's designated Guangzhou freight forwarder or trusted China-to-Africa cargo routes.

## 3. Wholesale Product Catalog Categories

1. **African Dresses** (`https://zamique.com/wholesale/african-dresses`)
   - Maxi dresses, pleated swing dresses, asymmetrical hem occasion wear, cocktail gowns, Ankara motif inspired silhouettes.
2. **Two Piece Sets** (`https://zamique.com/wholesale/two-piece-sets`)
   - Peplum top and pencil skirt sets, blazer and trouser combinations, coordinated print executive sets.
3. **Plus Size Women's Clothing** (`https://zamique.com/wholesale/plus-size-womens-clothing`)
   - Extended size dresses, 4XL generous cuts (120cm bust, 142cm length), structured wrap dresses.
4. **Ready-Stock Fashion** (`https://zamique.com/wholesale/ready-stock`)
   - Instant-dispatch wholesale stock in Guangzhou, verified on live WhatsApp video/photos.
5. **Custom Orders & Tech Pack Manufacturing** (`https://zamique.com/custom-orders`)
   - Direct manufacturing from buyer design sketches, photos, tech packs, or original samples.

## 4. African Regional Market Services

- **Nigeria (Lagos, Abuja, Onitsha, Kano)** (`https://zamique.com/markets/nigeria`):
  - Deep experience with Lagos cargo agents at Guangzhou Africa freight hubs.
  - Popular styles: Bold pleated maxi dresses, luxury peplum sets, 4XL celebratory occasion wear.
- **Ghana (Accra, Kumasi)** (`https://zamique.com/markets/ghana`):
  - Weekly cargo consolidation to Accra depot. High demand for coordinated blazer sets and vibrant occasion maxi gowns.
- **Kenya (Nairobi, Mombasa)** (`https://zamique.com/markets/kenya`):
  - Fast air cargo and sea freight coordination. High preference for knit dresses, structured sets, and modern African evening dresses.
- **Tanzania (Dar es Salaam)** (`https://zamique.com/markets/tanzania`):
  - Kariakoo market and boutique supply; modest yet elegant silhouettes with generous fabric sweeps.
- **South Africa (Johannesburg, Durban, Cape Town)** (`https://zamique.com/markets/south-africa`):
  - Contemporary boutique fashion, elegant cocktail wear, and plus-size inclusive ranges.

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q: Can African boutique owners start with a small trial order?**
A: Yes. Jack African Fashion offers ready-stock wholesale starting at 100 pieces per style across 68 featured designs.

**Q: Where can I see photos and videos of real stock before paying?**
A: Contact the Guangzhou sales team directly via WhatsApp (+86 189 2625 7367) for live photos, measurement verification, and fabric close-up videos.

**Q: How does shipping from Guangzhou to African cities work?**
A: Jack African Fashion checks, counts, and packs the goods in Guangzhou, then hands them over to the buyer's nominated shipping agent in Guangzhou or helps coordinate an established door-to-door or clearing agent route.
